setup.name: drop_08b_sglang_mtp
setup.cmd: cd /workspace/results/bench/q35_0.8b && /root/work/clientenv/bin/python -c "import json;L=[json.loads(x) for x in open('results.jsonl') if x.strip()];K=[r for r in L if not (r['tag']=='mtp' and r['arm']=='sglang')];open('results.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in K));print(len(L)-len(K),'dropped')" && rm -f stages/mtp_sglang_r*.done

setup.name: rust_frontend_main_tree
setup.cmd: export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; export HF_HOME=/root/work/hf; cd /root/work/mstar-main && cargo build --release --manifest-path rust/server/Cargo.toml

setup.name: install_vllm_omni
setup.cmd: export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; export HF_HOME=/root/work/hf; cd /root/work/engines && (test -x vllm-omni/bin/python || uv venv --python 3.12 --managed-python --seed vllm-omni) && uv pip install --python vllm-omni/bin/python --torch-backend=auto 'vllm-omni==0.30.0' ninja aiohttp && uv pip freeze --python vllm-omni/bin/python | grep -iE '^(vllm|vllm-omni|torch|transformers)=='

setup.name: install_sglang_omni
setup.cmd: export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; export HF_HOME=/root/work/hf; cd /root/work/engines && (test -x sglang-omni/bin/python || uv venv --python 3.12 --managed-python --seed sglang-omni) && uv pip install --python sglang-omni/bin/python --torch-backend=auto 'sglang-omni==0.1.9' ninja aiohttp && uv pip freeze --python sglang-omni/bin/python | grep -iE '^(sglang|sglang-omni|torch|transformers)=='

setup.name: weights_qwen3_omni
setup.cmd: export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; export HF_HOME=/root/work/hf; /root/work/mstar/.venv/bin/python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download as s; print(s('Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct'))"

setup.name: vllm_for_vllm_omni
setup.cmd: export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH; export HF_HOME=/root/work/hf; cd /root/work/engines && uv pip install --python vllm-omni/bin/python --torch-backend=auto 'vllm==0.30.0' 'vllm-omni==0.30.0' && uv pip install --python vllm-omni/bin/python --torch-backend=cpu --reinstall-package torchaudio --no-deps 'torchaudio==2.11.0' && vllm-omni/bin/python -c 'import vllm, vllm_omni; print(vllm.__version__)' && uv pip freeze --python vllm-omni/bin/python | grep -iE '^(vllm|vllm-omni|torch|transformers|flashinfer-python)=='

setup.name: omni_client_copy
setup.cmd: rm -rf /root/work/bench/omni_client && mkdir -p /root/work/bench/omni_client && cp -r /root/work/mstar-main/benchmark /root/work/bench/omni_client/ && find /root/work/bench/omni_client -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; ls /root/work/bench/omni_client/benchmark/runner.py

setup.name: whisper_weights

setup.name: vision_omni_datasets
